outcome.description: After the district court dismissed the first amended complaint in 2019, the Second Circuit reversed in 2020 (968 F.3d 204), holding the non-disclosure of the working capital loan to the operator actionable and scienter adequately pleaded. On remand the court largely denied a renewed motion to dismiss (Sept. 28, 2021). The parties then settled; the court granted preliminary approval on December 27, 2022, and on April 25, 2023 entered an Order and Final Judgment approving a $30,750,000 cash settlement for the class of Omega securities purchasers (https://storage.courtlistener.com/recap/gov.uscourts.nysd.484014/gov.uscourts.nysd.484014.167.0.pdf). Attorneys' fees were paid out of the settlement fund.
outcome.finalNote: Court-approved class settlement of $30.75 million (S.D.N.Y. Order and Final Judgment, ECF No. 167, April 25, 2023); fees came out of the fund; no appeal of the settlement.

Removed: the procedural history, the pleading standards, and every sentence stating the court's analysis or conclusions.
